notes: BUU 2.0 v2.2.1 - data-integrity release. Lossless reclaim: when the elastic pool retired a worker mid-batch, it could silently abandon the un-started tail of that worker's batch - rows that were handed out but never run, so they vanished and the pool still reported 'complete'. Now a worker finishes its current row, hands its remaining rows back, and exits; the coordinator re-queues them (skipping anything already done) so another worker picks them up, and the pool can't report done while any row is outstanding. Also: the 'Auto' license check and the elastic recheck now log out their PestPac session instead of leaving a consumed license behind; the free-license count is read from the PestPac panel with an exact label match (no more reading used/total or a Mobile/RouteOp table); and the end-of-run logout sweep's login selector is fixed so the sweep actually runs. Small fixes: the Read field 'Save as column' box no longer loses focus per keystroke, and worker cards have a clearer box. Built on 2.2.0 (Read field step) and 2.1.2 (bulletproof logout, login-overlay fix, per-worker stop, setup/teardown scope).
